rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for an electrical appliance at home or in an office.

example.english: The office bought an appliance for the pantry.
example.traditional: 公司新買咗部電器，放喺茶水間用。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 san1 maai5 zo2 bou6 din6 hei3 fong3 hai2 caa4 seoi2 gaan1 jung6

rows.note: Use this specifically for appliances used in the home, especially when discussing buying or replacing household equipment.

example.english: I want to replace a household appliance while there are discounts.
example.traditional: 我想趁而家做緊優惠，換部家電。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 can3 ji4 gaa1 zou6 gan2 jau1 wai6 wun6 bou6 gaa1 din6
